The '''Sel Zonn Station''' was a [[XQ2 Platform]] that [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Brentaal IV/Legends|Brentaal IV]]. Locations aboard the [[Space station/Legends|station]] included:<br />
*[[The Promenade (Sel Zonn Station)|The Promenade]]:
**[[Gundark's Cantina]], named for owner "Gundark" [[Saff]], was a popular meeting place for both indigenous and transient members of the station's population.
**[[The Credit Chip]], [[Cecil Vane]]'s casino, offered [[Sabacc/Legends|sabacc]] and [[Pazaak/Legends|pazaak]] games.
**[[Delgas Medical Supplies]]: A corporate medical practice and pharmaceutical supplier. The chief doctor in the practice was [[Byra Fenn]].
**The [[Droid/Legends|droid]] repair and sales shop [[Mechanical Allies]], run by [[San]].
*[[Deep Storage Bay V14]]
*[[Blue Deck]]
